target_customer: Sales teams that make and take many phone calls
problem: Sales teams used generic phone systems that were not tied to CRM data, so calls were hard to log and manage.
business_model: business phone system subscription (per CB Insights, phones integrated with CRM); pricing not found

founders.name: David Dolphin
prior_employers: Airbnb (telecom infrastructure and customer support systems)
education: MSc in Quantum Information Science (institution not named)

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a hosted phone system with CRM integration needs telephony know how, though carriers and APIs existed; the CEO had Airbnb telecom experience per the YC page.

defensibility.rationale: Telephony APIs lowered the barrier, and sales phone systems were copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated source found describing incumbents or their response.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand was found beyond the YC description of a phone system for sales teams.

branding.domain_note: Original product site pingm.net per the YC page; no domain history found.

identity.logo: not described in any source found

rebrands.why: not stated; the YC page says 'Formerly Pingm'

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found about either name, and the rename to a generic name lost the shorter coined one.

outcome_analysis: PhoneSys, formerly Pingm, aimed to be the phone system for sales teams and took a reported $125K seed that includes Y Combinator, but no press coverage, traction, exit or shutdown account was found. The cause of its inactive status is not public, so no failure factors are assigned and the record is thin.
notes: pingm.net returned HTTP 503 so the site is treated as unavailable. The $125K seed rests on Dealroom alone; CB Insights dates a Y Combinator seed to August 31 2011 without an amount, and lists the company as alive while YC lists it inactive. The competitor search returned only current vendor comparison pages with no 2011 or 2012 dated sources, so the list is empty. The roundfunded page is a reconstruction and was not used.
